verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch supports pre-request scripts (gh-5) and CLI-based test running (docs-8, docs-9) which enable chaining and data manipulation, but evidence for full pre-request AND post-response scripting with request chaining is thin — only pre-request scripting is explicitly documented, with no direct mention of post-response scripts or explicit chaining APIs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of post-response scripting, examples of chaining requests via scripts, independent hands-on verification of scripting workflow.
